attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determines if corporation must file Georgia state tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus. Nexus types: Physical presence (office, employees, property) or Economic nexus post-Wayfair ($100,000 gross receipts threshold).

condition_details.condition_comment: Has physical presence in GA (office, employees, property)
condition_details.condition_dsl: apportionment.has_physical_presence is equal to true and apportionment.state_code is equal to "GA"
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq { pop apportionment.state_code "GA" streq } over if

condition_details.condition_dsl: apportionment.has_economic_nexus is equal to true and apportionment.state_code is equal to "GA"
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true beq { pop apportionment.state_code "GA" streq } over if

action_details.action_dsl: add "GA filing required: Physical presence (office, employees, or property in state). Reference: GA Code § 48-7-21, § 48-7-31" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: "GA filing required: Physical presence (office, employees, or property in state). Reference: GA Code § 48-7-21, § 48-7-31" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Economic nexus established per Wayfair; Filing required due to economic nexus. Threshold: $100,000 gross receipts OR 200 transactions.
action_details.action_dsl: add "GA filing required: Economic nexus (post-Wayfair). Threshold: $100,000 gross receipts OR 200 transactions. Reference: GA Code § 48-8-2(8)(K)" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: "GA filing required: Economic nexus (post-Wayfair). Threshold: $100,000 gross receipts OR 200 transactions. Reference: GA Code § 48-8-2(8)(K)" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Georgia state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income. Common GA additions: Interest on U.S. government obligations, IRC Section 199A deduction addback, State income taxes deducted federally. Common GA subtractions: Interest on Georgia state and local bonds, Georgia NOL deduction.

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to calculate adjustments; apportionment.has_economic_nexus is equal to true or apportionment.has_physical_presence is equal to true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true beq { pop apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq } over not if

action_details.action_comment: Calculate GA state additions and subtractions; Calculate Georgia state-specific income adjustments to federal taxable income per GA Form 600 Schedule 1.
action_details.action_dsl: set apportionment.state_additions = 0.0; set apportionment.state_subtractions = 0.0; add ((("GA income adjustments calculated. Additions: " + string value of (apportionment.state_additions)) + ", Subtractions: ") + string value of (apportionment.state_subtractions)) + ". Reference: GA Form 600 Schedule 1, GA Code § 48-7-27" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef "GA income adjustments calculated. Additions: " apportionment.state_additions cvs strconcat ", Subtractions: " strconcat apportionment.state_subtractions cvs strconcat ". Reference: GA Form 600 Schedule 1, GA Code § 48-7-27" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Georgia state corporate income tax. Applies 5.75% flat rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income. Process: 1) Federal taxable income apportioned to GA (table 7500), 2) Add GA-specific additions (table 51120), 3) Subtract GA-specific subtractions (table 51120), 4) Apply GA tax rate 5.75%, 5) Subtract GA state credits, 6) Calculate refund or amount owed.

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to owe tax; apportionment.has_economic_nexus is equal to true or apportionment.has_physical_presence is equal to true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true beq { pop apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq } over not if

condition_details.condition_comment: Has positive state taxable income; apportionment.state_taxable_income is greater than 0

action_details.action_comment: Calculate GA tax at 5.75% flat rate; Georgia state corporate income tax calculation: Apply 5.75% flat rate, subtract credits, calculate refund or amount owed.
action_details.action_dsl: set apportionment.state_tax = apportionment.state_taxable_income * apportionment.state_tax_rate; set apportionment.state_tax = the maximum of (apportionment.state_tax - apportionment.state_credits) and (0.0); set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments - apportionment.state_tax; add ((((((("GA tax calculation: Taxable income: $" + string value of (apportionment.state_taxable_income)) + " x 5.75% = $") + string value of (apportionment.state_tax)) + ". Credits: $") + string value of (apportionment.state_credits)) + ". Final tax: $") + string value of (apportionment.state_tax)) + ". Reference: GA Form 600, GA Code § 48-7-21" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: apportionment.state_taxable_income apportionment.state_tax_rate fmul cvi /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_tax apportionment.state_credits f- 0.0 fmax cvi /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments apportionment.state_tax - cvi /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "GA tax calculation: Taxable income: $" apportionment.state_taxable_income cvs strconcat " x 5.75% = $" strconcat apportionment.state_tax cvs strconcat ". Credits: $" strconcat apportionment.state_credits cvs strconcat ". Final tax: $" strconcat apportionment.state_tax cvs strconcat ". Reference: GA Form 600, GA Code § 48-7-21" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No taxable income - no tax liability
